title: Explicit Frictional Contact Modeling in Neural Garment Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33492v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) simulate garments efficiently through physics-based self-supervision, but leave body-garment friction implicit or inside training energies, with no friction coefficient $\mu$ to set at inference; retraining the tested GNNs with a coefficient-specific friction term barely responds to $\mu$. Optimization-based solvers decide each contact's stick-slip state from the reaction that governs it, but only by re-optimizing the garment state at every step; a friction term in a one-pass training objective acts as a fixed-weight penalty on sliding, and the trained weights apply no per-contact Coulomb condition at inference. translated_title: 神经服装模拟中的显式摩擦接触建模
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNN）通过基于物理的自监督学习高效地模拟服装，但将人体与服装之间的摩擦隐式处理或封装在训练能量中，导致推理时没有可设置的摩擦系数 μ；用特定系数的摩擦项重新训练所测试的 GNN 后，其对 μ 的响应几乎为零。基于优化的求解器可以根据决定每个接触点的约束反力来确定其粘滞-滑动状态，但这只有在每一步都重新优化服装状态时才能实现；而单次前向传递训练目标中的摩擦项只是对滑动的一种固定权重惩罚，训练得到的权重在推理时并不会对每个接触点施加库仑条件。因此，我们在预测之后显式地解析摩擦：一个模块化接触算子附着在冻结的预测器上，无需重新训练或迭代求解，即可估计法向载荷，沿跨越人体三角形的路径施加闭式库仑修正，并传播由此产生的运动……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种可附加在冻结预测器上的模块化接触算子，无需重新训练或迭代求解即可在神经服装预测后显式施加闭式库仑摩擦修正，使摩擦系数在推理阶段可直接调节并真实影响模拟结果。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a Modular Contact Operator attached to a frozen neural garment predictor that explicitly applies closed-form Coulomb friction corrections after prediction—without retraining or iterative solving—so the friction coefficient can be directly controlled at inference time.
